integrity.proof_basis: Analytic jump decomposition and explicit Legendre kernel plus exact rational polynomial/interval certificate
integrity.source_provenance: The July 4, 2016 date is the first arXiv posting of a directly relevant orthogonal-polynomial projection study, not a claim about the first historical appearance of Legendre projections

scientific_limitations: Real unweighted interval [-1,1] and projector onto polynomials of degree at most three only
The exhaustive rational interval certificate is part of the proof and must be executed or independently verified for full reproducibility
Historical priority is qualified by inaccessible older full texts; absence in searched databases is not a uniqueness proof
title: Sharp bounded-variation norm of the cubic Legendre projector
